services.value: ASI provides environmental microbiological testing and analysis for water, wastewater/reclaimed water/stormwater, and biosolids, including testing for Cryptosporidium/Giardia, LT2, Legionella, microbial identification, microscopic particulate analysis, virus analysis, general microbiology, and electron microscopy. The site also lists consulting, research & development, ATP studies, and challenge studies.
